title: Choose the body by the reference's figure type (mannequin vs bare human)
summary: A segmented mannequin read as a wooden doll beside smooth AI figures; the kit's bare human (outfit 'none') matched. Same skeleton, clips and IK: make the body a switch.

versions.note: seed harvest of the shot-match scenes (L3)

usage.example: const f = MANNEQUIN ? glow(rebindMannequin(figure(spec, o), MODELS.man)) : glowPerson(name, o);   // the recipes' MANNEQUIN switch

doc.when: Glowing/stylised people matched to a reference.
gotchas: The owner liked the mannequin in the café and dig shots; the tunnel reference needed the smooth body.

problem.symptom: Figures read as wooden dolls (or as too slim/smooth) next to the reference.
problem.cause: The body type doesn't match the reference's figure style.
problem.fix: Switch between the mannequin and the bare human (same rig).
